title: After 1000 Rejections, I Learned This...
description: Choe credits his immigrant mother's door-to-door persistence with teaching him that rejection is temporary, connecting childhood muteness and compulsive rituals to repeated applications, changing taste and the patient work needed while an opportunity remains unavailable.
